about_the_game:
Victory is Decided Before the Battle Begins


Seal of Magic is a turn-based auto-battle roguelike where your Spirits lead the charge.
As the strategist, your role is crucial during the pre-battle preparation phase. Empower your Spirits by attaching "Seals"—mystical stickers with unique powers—into their slots. Grant them the perfect abilities and lead your team to victory.

The Strategic Seal Drafting




During the preparation phase, you must face the Seal Draft. You will be presented with two Seals and must choose one to claim. But beware: the Seal you don't pick falls into the enemy's hands, strengthening them instead.
Do you take the effect you need most, or prioritize denying a powerful buff to your foe? This single choice can change the entire tide of game.

Deplete and Unleash: Seal Purge




Seals have a limited lifespan known as the "Seal Count", which decreases every time their effect activates. Once the count hits zero, the Seal loses its power. However, by overwriting it with a new Seal to "Purge" it, you gain elemental resources and trigger a devastating Purge Effect.

Amplify Power with Elemental Resources




By gathering elemental resources through Seal Purging and other methods, you permanently boost the potency of Seals of that element.
Higher-level elemental effects allow you to grow your Spirits with maximum efficiency, keeping you one step ahead of the rising darkness.

Watch Your Strategy Unfold in Auto-Battle


Once your preparations are complete, sit back and trust your Spirits.
In turn-based auto-battles, they will automatically perform actions like attacking, debuffing, supporting, and exploring. Win to advance to the next wave—lose, and it’s game over.

short_description: Support your Spirits with powerful Seals! Seal of Magic is a turn-based auto-battle roguelike where prep is everything. Compete with enemies to draft Seals and slot them in to empower your team. Grow your Spirits efficiently to survive the ever-stronger threats ahead!
